tests.name: a notes query that looks like one of kb's options reaches kb as the query, from every search path
tests.why: runs an argparse stand-in for kb with option-like queries through notes, forMessage and search; on base the query lands before --json without a marker so argparse reads it as an option

tests.name: every query is the last argument, after kb's end-of-options marker
tests.why: checks kbSearchArgs puts the query last after --; title quotes MUST 1's end-of-options marker wording; kbSearchArgs is new

tests.name: a query is only ever searched as text (TD-26) > searches a query that looks like a git grep option as text, never as an option
tests.why: git grep already received the query after -e on base (src/host/text-search.ts unchanged there), so this new test guards existing behaviour; covers the git grep member of MUST 1

tests.name: a query is only ever searched as text (TD-26) > trims surrounding whitespace and newlines, then finds what the bare query finds, in git and in the walk
tests.why: the trim rule for git grep and the folder walk is new in src/host/text-search.ts

tests.name: a query is only ever searched as text (TD-26) > refuses an empty query, one of only newlines, and one with a line break inside
tests.why: textQuery refusal of empty, newline-only and inner-newline queries is new

tests.name: a notes query that looks like one of kb's options reaches kb as the query, from every search path
tests.why: its last assertion checks a notes query wrapped in newlines reaches kb trimmed (kb route of the same rule)

tests.name: passes kb's arguments as a list, with sources for the agent's own search
tests.why: asserts the exact argument array handed to the kb runner with a shell-like query; expectation changed to the new layout so it fails on base

tests.name: a query is only ever searched as text (TD-26) > searches a query that looks like a git grep option as text, never as an option
tests.why: a pager-command query must not create the marker file, which a shell string would allow; git grep was already spawned with an array at base

tests.name: searching text in a git workspace > finds every hit in a file with its line, case-insensitive for a lower-case query
tests.why: unchanged test of an ordinary git grep query covering the changed searchText entry

tests.name: searching text in a folder that is not a git repository > walks the folder, skipping node_modules, big and binary files and symlinks
tests.why: unchanged test of an ordinary walk query through the changed walkSearch entry

tests.name: reads kb's outcomes: hits, none, outside every source, a timeout and bad output
tests.why: unchanged kb test of ordinary queries going through the changed argument builder and fake runner

notes: Control item: no findings listed. Tests cite debt rows TD-3/TD-26 rather than MUST numbers, so only the end-of-options title counts as strict. The git grep member already used -e at base, so the new git-grep option test is classed PASS_TO_PASS. The it.each literal-matching test was skipped because its printed name holds shell metacharacters.
